description: This file implements the 'Surfaces' class, which manages Wayland surface events such as frame updates, creation, and destruction, and handles associated callbacks.

classes.name: Surfaces
classes.description: A class that manages Wayland surface events and their callbacks, including frame handling and surface lifecycle events.

methods.name: void SetFrameCallback(FrameCallback callback)
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be invoked when a new frame is available for a surface.

methods.name: void SetDisplayEventCallback(DisplayEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be invoked on display-related events such as creation and destruction.

methods.name: void SetFramesAreRGBA(bool frames_are_rgba)
methods.description: Configures whether frames are assumed to be in RGBA format.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceFrame(std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t frame_width,std::uint32_t frame_height,std::uint32_t frame_fourcc_format,std::uint32_t frame_stride_bytes,std::uint8_t * frame_bytes)
methods.description: Handles a new surface frame, potentially converting format and invoking the frame callback.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceCreated(std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t display_width,std::uint32_t display_height)
methods.description: Handles the event of a surface being created and triggers the display event callback.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceDestroyed(std::uint32_t display_number)
methods.description: Handles the destruction of a surface and triggers the display event callback.

ctags.name: HandleSurfaceFrame
ctags.signature: (std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t frame_width,std::uint32_t frame_height,std::uint32_t frame_fourcc_format,std::uint32_t frame_stride_bytes,std::uint8_t * frame_bytes)
